_meta.description: Clean daily sales time series spanning 2 years. No injected quality issues. units_sold has 4 statistical outliers from natural variance at the extreme of the (revenue/price) range — these are legitimate business events, not errors. promotions_spend has a strong correlation with revenue (r=0.879) by design. This is a precision benchmark alongside sales_clean.

score.note: No real quality issues. Score below 80 indicates false positives. The 4 units_sold outliers are legitimate high-sales days; Claude may give 84-100 depending on how it weights them.

optional_findings.note: 4 statistical outliers from natural variance. Legitimate high-sales days. At most info-level.

forbidden_findings.note: Zero nulls exist in this dataset. Any null_rate finding is a false positive.
All string columns (region, channel) use consistent capitalisation. Any inconsistent_format finding is a false positive.

forbidden_severity_overrides.note: Natural variance in a clean dataset. Warning or critical would be incorrect.
